annotations.title: Check pick-and-place and BOM files against the board

description: Compare the files an assembler receives with the KiCad board they were exported from: every placed surface-mount part is in the position file and the reverse, no reference twice, do-not-populate respected, side, units (mm or inch, found from the board), position (after finding the one origin offset and Y direction the file shares, and whether bottom-side X was negated), rotation on both sides against what KiCad itself writes, whether parts of one footprint carry one rotation correction, and BOM coverage in both directions. With assembler 'jlcpcb' it also checks JLCPCB's documented columns, millimetres and Layer values, and the bottom-side form the open-source KiCad-to-JLCPCB exporters write (X not negated, rotation 180 minus the board's); JLCPCB does not document its bottom side, so those checks are marked certainty 'likely' with their basis. It canNOT verify pin-1 orientation on the assembler's machine (that depends on each part's orientation in its reel, which no public source gives) and applies NO rotation table; a corrected rotation is reported, not judged. Every check states its basis and certainty. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

assembler.description: Also hold the position file against this assembler's documented format and the bottom-side form its exporters write.

bom_csv.description: The BOM as CSV with a column of references.

position_csv.description: The position (pick-and-place) file as CSV: KiCad's Ref,Val,Package,PosX,PosY,Rot,Side or an assembler's Designator,Mid X,Mid Y,Layer,Rotation.
